# SD18 deterministic Human Rogue level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Rogue pilot from the bounded
# level-13 ceiling (tests/sd18_rogue_level13_widening.rs) to level 14 as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice
# seam and the deterministic ability/feat/skill posture from the level-13
# fixture, including the sixth numbered rogue-talent choice slot, and adds
# the SEVENTH numbered rogue-talent choice slot (rogue talents land at
# 2/4/6/8/10/12/14 per "Starting at 2nd level, a rogue gains one rogue
# talent. She gains an additional rogue talent for every 2 levels of rogue
# attained after 2nd level."; level 14 is a talent level, per the PF1 Core
# Rulebook Rogue class table's level-14 "Special" column, which reads only
# "Rogue talent"), adding the level bump plus the new talent selection.
